list_courses.name: list_courses
list_courses.description: List accessible courses and whether they are open.

find_students.name: find_students
find_students.description: Find accessible students by name, with optional status and course filters. Course filter includes active memberships only.

get_student_details.name: get_student_details
get_student_details.description: Get one accessible student profile, enrollments and effective attendance and notes. Optional course scopes attendance and selected level.

get_course_attendance_view.name: get_course_attendance_view
get_course_attendance_view.description: Read the session roster and marks for a course and date, including event IDs for sync_attendance. Choose overview for six-session follow-up and all-date totals, or chart for anonymous chart rows and the browser export link. Use none for historical unscoped records.

get_notebook.name: get_notebook
get_notebook.description: Get your authorized roster, courses, enrollments, event history and notes. Attendance events use enrollment IDs to identify courses.

get_attendance_summary.name: get_attendance_summary
get_attendance_summary.description: Project your authorized notebook events into current attendance and notes; reversed events are excluded and legacy early/late marks count as present.

update_student.name: update_student
update_student.description: Update an active assigned student’s name and contact details.

append_events.name: append_events
append_events.description: Append attendance, tagged notes or corrections. Supply stable IDs and client times for safe retries. New attendance must reference an active enrollment in an open course.

sync_attendance.name: sync_attendance
sync_attendance.description: Compare and commit attendance records. Supply the expected event ID (or null) and stable event ID/time; returns per-record conflicts.

sync_student.name: sync_student
sync_student.description: Compare and update a student contact or append a note with stable ID and time.

get_course_workflow.name: get_course_workflow
get_course_workflow.description: Get paginated course membership, grades, or result readiness. Search student names using the notebook matcher. Grades close readiness uses saved data only; manual closure is independent.

get_notebook_history.name: get_notebook_history
get_notebook_history.description: Read administrator notebook history in server order, newest first. Reversals retain their target and undone records remain visible.

get_admin_board.name: get_admin_board
get_admin_board.description: Get accounts, teachers and full student register for administration.

export_course_report.name: export_course_report
export_course_report.description: Export a saved course report as rows or an Excel workbook. Both formats use the website’s default columns. Request optional columns explicitly, including contact details for full or student reports.

columns.description: Columns to include in the requested order. Omit to use the website defaults.

invite_accounts.name: invite_accounts
invite_accounts.description: Create invited accounts and open the private invitation message. Set phoneConfirmed to true only after the administrator explicitly confirms they asked each account holder directly. A request ID cannot be reused after success.

grant_account.description: Grant or change an application role and access.
